observations.body: Jeremiah recalls Israel following the LORD through the wilderness.
observations.label: Following before accusation

observations.body: The wilderness first appears as the place of remembered devotion and then as evidence against later leaders.
observations.label: Wilderness role

payload.posture: Read Jeremiah 2:1–8 as its own wilderness scene before relating it to other journeys, memories, or visions.
payload.tension: Early faithfulness sharpens the charge without claiming that the wilderness generation never failed.
payload.title: Devotion in a land not sown
